Part.name: Duplet panel (hull)
Part.description: Duplet - modular hull panel (game proxy) Resize X/Z to add whole cells (1x1 up to 8x8): 125 x 250 mm per cell, 53 mm deep. Each cell has a 15 mm formed front plate, two 12 mm Nozh layers with a 10 mm steel plate between them, and bolts on every second cell corner. Both layers of a cell spend independently, front layer first. Plates: 2 | Layers: 2 Effective angles: 30-70° (best APFSDS) Kinetic (APFSDS) at 60°: 30% less pen. Chemical (HEAT) at 60°: 70% less pen. Tandem: no guaranteed protection Extra loss, reference L/D 30; all layers intact Mass and cost scale with paid cell area only, never depth
